entry.title: Zero-Copy Region Inference for Asynchronous Rust State Machines
entry.summary:
We formalize a region-based borrow analysis for async/await state machines in Rust that eliminates redundant heap allocations across suspension points. By proving soundness over a core calculus with lifetime projections, our compiler pass reduces generator frame sizes by $38\%$ and improves tail latency by $1.42\times$ on high-concurrency Tokio workloads without unsafe code.

Source: arXiv CS (cs.PL) · Tags: #rust #compilers #performance

entry.title: Cross-Cache Speculative Type Confusion in Modern Browser JIT Tier-Up Pipelines
entry.summary:
Optimizing JIT compilers elide bounds and map checks when profiling feedback indicates monomorphic object shapes. We demonstrate a speculative race condition during concurrent background compilation that leaks arbitrary WebAssembly linear memory across site isolation boundaries in under $90\text{ ms}$, along with a zero-overhead fence mitigation.

Source: Google Project Zero / InfoSec · Tags: #infosec #compilers #performance
